name: Author mode
for: Daily DITA writing with CSS rendering and content completion.
notFor: Hand-editing well-formedness emergencies or XSD design.

name: Text mode
for: Surgery on tags, entities, and broken well-formedness.
notFor: Writing a whole chapter by typing angle brackets.

name: DITA Maps Manager
for: The book: topicrefs, keys, completeness, transforms.
notFor: Treating the tree as the filesystem.

name: Outline
for: Jump the element tree of the current topic.

name: Attributes
for: id, keys, href, props on the selected node.

name: Review
for: Track changes and comments in Oxygen.
notFor: Mixing Content Fusion comments and Guides review on the same file by accident.

name: Page Editor
for: In-place component authoring on an AEM template.

name: Universal Editor
for: Visual editing of instrumented pages, including headless/edge cases.

name: Guides web editor
for: Browser DITA on AEM: SMEs, review, baselines.

name: Content Fragments
for: Headless structured fields without a page tree.
